ai_summary: DigiLocker is a free digital document wallet issuing and storing verified e-documents via Aadhaar login.
ai_explanation: DigiLocker lets citizens store and share government-issued digital documents (marksheets, driving licences, certificates) fetched directly from issuers, reducing physical paperwork. Sign-up uses Aadhaar OTP. e-Documents are legally recognised under the IT Act.
eligibility_summary: Indian citizens with Aadhaar (used for sign-up).

conversation_examples.bot: DigiLocker is a free digital document wallet issuing and storing verified e-documents via Aadhaar login. Apply: https://digilocker.gov.in/signin. Helpline: 1800-153-374 / support via portal.
